sentence: This project builds models that use images, text and tabular data to predict damage to infrastructure soon after a major disaster.
This project builds machine learning models that identify cell types as stem cells differentiate, and explain which genes or image features matter.
This project studies insect and nematode pests that affect agriculture and human health and builds tools to manage them.
This project builds tools that help software engineers make better decisions when they change source code.
This project improves a mass spectrometry method so it can show the structure of proteins and their binding with much finer detail.
This project builds small cryogenic chips that control and read out qubits so quantum systems can grow to thousands of qubits.
This project uses a laser to create color centers in hexagonal boron nitride and studies how their atomic structure affects the light they give off.
This project builds AI tools that follow physical principles and safety constraints while they generate designs.
This project builds deep learning models that predict patient outcomes from text, images and lab values collected over time, and explain why.
This project studies abstract algebraic structures called braided tensor categories and works to classify them.
This project uses traits of biological ecosystems such as food webs to build tools that help engineers design systems that recover from disruptions.
This project studies how small mammals and food webs in semi-arid ecosystems respond to rainfall pulses.
This project uses arrays of nanoscale magnets to test whether energy fluctuations in small systems briefly appear to break the second law of thermodynamics.
This project studies whether clownfish behavior, diet and microbes help explain why their color patterns match the anemones they live in.
This project combines deep learning with probabilistic perception so robots can tell how sure they are of their predictions.
This project studies how biofilms growing on microplastics change the way microplastics move through water.
This project builds a model that describes how mechanical metamaterials respond to forces and imperfections, using tools from statistical physics.
This project studies how crabs molt by measuring the proteins in their tissues at different stages of molting.
